title: FastMaicra: Beernia
description: Minecraft modpack FAST, bye bye to low fps.
body:
### _1.20.6 requires Java 21._


_Minecraft modpack FAST, bye bye to low fps.
Why bore you with a lot of text to sell you the motorcycle? almost all modpacks contain the same mods._

### **Beernia Styles**
We added 100% performance mods that leave the game intact in its classic style, but with colorful touches that make it more striking and refreshing.
These are basically 100% Vanilla Fabric performance mods, but with other mods that everyone wants: Sit, move your legs when climbing stairs and more animations, flashy progress plates, map and minimap. And totally Shader ready if you wanted to put something in.

**Q**: Do I need the modpack on the server?

**A**: No.
